spacing_validation.raw_nifti_test_explanation: Nibabel normalized zero-valued pixdim to 1 before application validation. The original test therefore did not demonstrate detection of malformed raw spacing metadata.
spacing_validation.known_limitation: The application validates spacing values returned by the NIfTI loader. It cannot reliably detect missing or invalid spacing that has already been repaired or replaced with defaults by the reader.

scientific_scope.evaluation_scope: Previously established CAMUS patient-level evaluation partition; not independent external clinical validation.
